en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.786 - It was narrated by Abdullah ibn Sinan

from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), was asked about a man who has nothing but trousers (for covering).
Imam (as) said: "He should untie the waistband and place it over his shoulder and pray. If he has a sword but no garment, he should hang the sword around himself and pray standing”.
